description: This file defines the 'Article' class within the Conduit.Domain namespace, representing articles in the application's domain model. It includes properties like Id, Slug, Title, Description, Body, Author, Comments, and metadata such as favorites and tags.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents an article with properties for content, author, comments, and metadata such as favorited status and tags.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Indicates whether the article has any favorites (likes).

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of favorites for the article.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Provides a list of tag identifiers associated with the article.
